tests.description: Adds unit tests for user deletion: deleteAccount_shouldAnonymizeUserData (P0) ensures user data is successfully anonymized in line with GDPR requirements, and deleteAccount_shouldThrowException_whenUserNotFound (P1) ensures a ResourceNotFoundException is thrown if the user is missing. Requires import org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled;.

Adds API integration tests for user deletion endpoint: deleteAccount_shouldReturn204AndRevokeToken_whenAuthenticated (P0) verifies DELETE /api/v1/profile/me returns 204 and revokes the active token, and deleteAccount_shouldReturn401_whenUnauthenticated (P1) ensures access is denied without a valid token. Requires import org.junit.jupiter.api.Disabled; and import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.delete;.
